note: Honest IR metrics from the frozen 150-Q harness over the committed cached 10-K corpus (AAPL/MSFT/NVDA). recall@k = fraction of in-document questions whose gold supporting chunk is in the top-k; citation_soundness = fraction of cited chunks entailed by the question under a deterministic lexical-overlap proxy (NOT a learned model); abstention_rate = fraction of adversarial out-of-document questions correctly abstained. No accuracy or alpha claim — this is an information-retrieval tool.
